title: 국립공업고등학교 설치령 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Special Cases concerning Personnel Exchanges)
(1) Notwithstanding Article 13-3 (1) of the Decree on the Appointment of Educational Officials, the superintendent of education in the jurisdiction where a national technical high school is located shall establish a personnel exchange plan that includes educational officials belonging to the national technical high school.
(2) When establishing a personnel exchange plan under paragraph (1), the superintendent of education shall consult in advance with the principal of the national technical high school concerning the scale, methods, etc. of personnel exchanges involving its educational officials.
